verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's only on-topic evidence is a marketing claim of corporate cards with "full spending control, flexible limits" [28], backed by SDK resources for managing cardholders and cards [26]. That is a first-party, card-scoped form of transaction limits. Nothing documents per-account or per-program limit configuration, velocity rules, holds on suspicious activity, or account freezes and reinstatement. Payment approval flows and IP allowlists are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: per-account/per-program limit configuration, velocity limits, suspicious-activity holds, account freeze with documented reinstatement paths, and first-party API docs or independent corroboration of limit controls.
